earth-gem.x: Earth gem is a quest item used for [[enchanting|enchanting]] obtained during « Tool Enchantment ».

mayors-hat.x: Mayor's hat is a quest item used for [[connor|Connor]]'s « Mayor's Lost Hat ». It can be found on the beach on the most southeastern portion of sand next to a tree and water after the quest is triggered.

jim-and-wife-photo.x: is a quest item to be given back to [[jim|Jim]].

treasure-map-second-piece.x: Treasure map second piece is a quest item used for [[zarah|Zarah]]'s « Fabled treasure ». This is randomly obtained from clearing trash/cutting kelp from the ocean using [[scythe|scythe]] after the mission is triggered. Currently vortexanator can't be used to obtain this.

treasure-map-third-piece.x: Treasure map third piece is a quest item used for [[zarah|Zarah]]'s « Fabled treasure ». This is obtained from destroying rocks/stones from the mine using [[pickaxe|pickaxe]] after the mission is triggered. Currently explosive can't be used to obtain this.

festival-tree-sapling.x: Festival tree sapling is a quest item used in [[tree-planting-festival|Tree Planting Festival]].

diving-suit-v2.x: Diving Suit V2 is a special item kept under player's journal. It will replace [[diving-suit|Diving Suit]] once obtained.

It is received from [[ling|Ling]] after seeing Merfolk for the first time as part of « Explore the ocean ». The player need to go to pier to trigger the cutscene with Ling, and she will return with the new suit two days later with another cutscene. This is required to make the puzzle in front of gate to [[merfolk-kingdom|Merfolk Kingdom]] appear upon healing 40 coral site.

auto-chest.x: is a Developed Equipment from the [[laboratory|Laboratory]] that automatically loads or unloads any that is directly on the right or the left of the chest. If you place a Automation chest right under another, it'll form a chain of Automation chests and artisan equipment that will be all linked to a common 40 places inventory.
Before it can be crafted, it has to be developed from the [[laboratory|Laboratory]]. and its crafting recipe will be obtained afterward.
Once development is done, can be [[crafting|crafted]] by the player.

can be placed next to artisan equipment to the left or right and it will perform corresponding automation with it (e.g. putting egg into mayonnaise maker, or collecting mayonnaise from it). s can be placed above or below next to another auto chest and it will form a conveyor belt. 2 or more chests that are linked together will still only have 40 storage slots.

grass-starter.x: is a special type of seeds that can be planted in any [[calendar|season]]. When [[farming|planted]], it will turn into grass but will not spread during winter.

medicine.x: Medicine is a consumable that can be purchased at the [[clinic|Clinic]] for 400 . Despite the description, the current buff effect only lasts for 2 hours.

vitamin-drink.x: Vitamin drink is a consumable that can be purchased from the [[clinic|Clinic]] for 2,000 .

catching-component.x: Catching component is component for [[sturdy-computer|sturdy computer]] that is automatically installed once purchased from [[laboratory|laboratory]].

[[sturdy-computer|Sturdy computer]] will have the ability to do insect and critter forecasting once [[catching-component|catching component]] is bought. It will show a UI with list of location, time and possible catchable insects and critters for that day. The list of possible catchables will change depends on the season and weather. If the UI is zoomed in, it will show the actual catchables in different spots in the map, either on land or under the sea. If they ran away, they will be indicated as textual "???" until they are completely gone from the map.

forage-component.x: Forage component is component for [[sturdy-computer|sturdy computer]] that is automatically installed once purchased from [[laboratory|laboratory]].

[[sturdy-computer|Sturdy computer]] will have the ability to do forage forecasting once [[forage-component|forage component]] is bought. It will show a UI with list of location and possible scavengeables for that day. The list of possible scavengeables will change depends on the season. If the UI is zoomed in, it will show the actual scavengeables in different spots in the map, either on land or under the sea.

fishing-component.x: Fishing component is component for [[sturdy-computer|sturdy computer]] that is automatically installed once purchased from [[laboratory|laboratory]].

[[sturdy-computer|Sturdy computer]] will have the ability to do fish forecasting once [[fishing-component|fishing component]] is bought. It will show a UI with list of location, time and possible catchable fish for that day. The list of possible catchables will change depends on the date, season, and weather. Currently, [[cavern|cavern]] is not included in fish location, hence fish like [[silver-arowana|silver arowana]] and [[red-king-arowana|red king arowana]] are not shown in the list.

farming-elixir.x: Farming elixir is a special [[consumables|consumable]]. Consuming a farming elixir adds one [[farming|farming]] skill point.
One farming elixir is available to purchase from the community center. Upon purchase, the player will immediately consume the elixir.

locket.x: Reach 8 hearts with any character to unlock. Can only be given to single characters with whom you have 8 hearts of friendship and have completed enough hangout events. Married NPCs do not want romance from you. Check the relationships tab for eligible characters and to see hangout requirements.

wellness-fruit.x: Wellness fruit is a special [[consumables|consumable]] rewarded for completing various aspects of the game. Eating a wellness fruit permanently increases the player's health by 45.
There are seven wellness fruits available in the current version of the game.
Consuming a wellness fruit grants the player a buff that permanently increases their maximum health by 45 and prevents the eating of another wellness fruit that day.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.
As wellness fruit have limited availability and a unique effect, care should be taken to not waste them on cooked dishes.

carrot-shed.x: Carrot shed is an special reward item that can be placed on a player's [[shed|Shed]] by visiting the [[carpenter|Carpenter]].

Carrot shed can be used to change the appearance of a shed on the farm.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently require the carrot shed.

fungarian-chest.x: Fungarian chest is a type of storage. The fungarian chest has a maximum capacity of 40 items.
When the player has the [[funguys-swarm|Funguys Swarm x Coral Island collaboration]] pack, they will receive the item and crafting recipe in mail
Fungarian chest can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player opened the mail.

A fungarian chest has a 40 slot capacity can be placed in an empty 1x1 space anywhere on the farm, in the farmhouse, in barns/coops, in the greenhouse, or in sheds - despite its description it cannot be placed elsewhere on the island. The chest functions similarly to other chests.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that need this item.

bamboo-net-small.x: Bamboo net small is an item that can be placed on quay, bridges, or river banks to passively catch [[small-fish-group|small fish]]. It can be enhanced by applying any [[bait|bait]].
Bamboo net small can be crafted after the player reaches level 3 in their [[fishing|Fishing]] mastery.
A bamboo net small can be placed in an empty 1x1 space near any water such as quay, bridges, sea shore, or river bank. It cannot be anywhere without any water nearby.
A placed bamboo net small can passively catch small fish or a trash. Using any [[bait|bait]] can boost it to catch a fish.
Bamboo net small cannot be gifted.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

bamboo-net-large.x: Bamboo net large is an item that can be placed on quay, bridges, or river banks to passively catch any [[fishing|fish]] sizes. It can be enhanced by applying any [[bait|bait]].

A bamboo net large can be placed in an empty 1x1 space near any water such as quay, bridges, sea shore, or river bank. It cannot be anywhere without any water nearby.
A placed bamboo net large can passively catch any fish or a trash. Using any [[bait|bait]] can boost it to catch a fish.

There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

Candied tree seed does not require an upgraded [[farmhouse|farmhouse]] and kitchen and can be crafted instantly in the menu.
Candied tree seed can be crafted after the player reaches level 1 in their [[foraging|Foraging]] mastery. A crafted candied tree seed sells for 11g more that the raw ingredients used to craft it.

wild-seeds.x: Wild seeds are a special type of seeds that can be planted in any [[calendar|season]]. When [[farming|planted]], these seeds turn into a seasonal [[crop|crop]].

Wild seeds can randomly be obtained by digging soil and clovers with a [[hoe|hoe]] and cutting weeds or grass with a [[scythe|scythe]]. [[crop|Crows]] that have eaten [[crop|crops]] may also drop wild seeds.
The crops the wild seeds turn in to depend on the current season. If there is more than one crop the seeds can turn into, the crop is chosen randomly.
If a wild seed is planted in the Greenhouse it will still turn in to a crop dependent on the current season.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

makeshift-chest.x: Makeshift chest is a type of storage that can hold most types of items. The makeshift chest has a capacity of 20 storage slots.
The player starts out already knowing how to [[crafting|craft]] makeshift chest.

A makeshift chest can be placed in an empty 1x1 space anywhere on the farm, in the farmhouse, in barns or coops, in the greenhouse, or in sheds. Once placed, it allows the player to store most types of items or tools in the game and also allows use of those items for in-menu crafting. The makeshift chest has a capacity of 20 slots to hold stacks of unique items.
Placed chests can only be returned to the inventory when empty of items, but can be freely moved using Decor mode if applicable.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

ground-insect-scent.x: Ground insect scent is a [[crafting|craft]]able [[consumables|consumable]] item. Once consumed, it will decrease ground insect awareness by 4% for 3 hours and 8 minutes. It can also be applied on [[ground-insect-trap|ground insect trap]].

crawling-critter-scent.x: Crawling critter scent is a [[crafting|craft]]able [[consumables|consumable]] item. Once consumed, it will decrease crawling sea critter awareness by 4% for 3 hours and 8 minutes. It can also be applied on [[crawler-trap|crawler trap]].

stamina-fruit.x: Stamina fruit is a special [[consumables|consumable]] rewarded for completing various aspects of the game. Eating a stamina fruit permanently increases the player's energy by 45 and refills it to the new max.
There are six stamina fruits available in the current version of the game.
Consuming a stamina fruit grants the player a buff that permanently increases their maximum energy by 45 and prevents the eating of another stamina fruit that day.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.
As stamina fruit have limited availability and a unique effect, care should be taken to not waste them on cooked dishes.

ground-insect-trap.x: Ground insect trap is an item that can be placed on the ground to passively catch [[insect|insect]]s. It can be enhanced by applying [[ground-insect-scent|ground insect scent]].
Ground insect trap can be crafted after the player reaches level 3 in their [[catching|Catching]] mastery.

A ground insect trap be placed in an empty 1x1 space in any outdoor area around the island, such as in the town, in the forest, or on the beach. It cannot be placed on the farm, in the cavern, underwater, or in any indoor space.

A placed ground insect trap can passively catch nearby insects or have a chance of one spawning inside of it overnight. Using a [[ground-insect-scent|ground insect scent]] guarantees an insect spawning overnight. The insects that can be caught are based on the insects that can naturally be found in the area where the trap is placed.
The ground insect trap can only be used to catch insects that crawl on the ground, such as beetles, spiders and caterpillars.
Ground insect traps may be destroyed after the player leaves a [[festival|festival]].
Ground insect trap cannot be gifted.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

crawler-trap.x: Crawler trap is an item that can be placed on the ocean ground to passively catch [[sea-critter|critter]]s. It can be enhanced by applying [[crawling-critter-scent|crawling critter scent]].
Crawler trap can be crafted after the player reaches level 5 in their [[catching|Catching]] mastery.
A crawler trap be placed in an empty 1x1 space in any outdoor space while diving. It cannot be placed in underwater caves, or in any indoor space.

A placed crawler trap can passively catch nearby critters or have a chance of one spawning inside of it overnight. Using a [[crawling-critter-scent|crawling critter scent]] guarantees a critter spawning overnight. The critters that can be caught are based on the critters that can naturally be found in the area where the trap is placed.
The crawler trap can only be used to catch critters that crawl on the sea floor, such as crabs, lobsters, and sea stars.
Crawler traps may be destroyed after the player leaves a [[festival|festival]].
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.
